requirements.statement: Semantic admission: 100% of requirements have full chain raw intent→requirement→claim→acceptance→task→owner→output→verifier→evidence→rollback; unresolved=[] before execution.
Take over the dirty worktree without reset/redo: full manifest of tracked/staged/unstaged/untracked; trace back from the pre-cut commit.
Unified global-behavior runtime: 11 owner modules with single flow; no module writes PASS or its own state.
Remove or merge ambiguous/duplicate module names (Decision Fabric, Decision Closure, Planner Runtime, multiple closure-*, context-*, routing paths).

Single vocabulary per domain: task_state DISCUSSING|PLANNED|EXECUTING|VERIFYING|COMPLETE|BLOCKED|NEEDS_USER; claim_outcome PASS|PARTIAL|BLOCKED|UNSUPPORTED|PRE-EXISTING|NEEDS_USER; host_state NOT_DETECTED|DETECTED|INSTALLED|OFFLINE_VERIFIED|LIVE_VERIFIED|FAILED; provider_state UNAVAILABLE|AVAILABLE|AUTHORIZED|ACTIVE|FAILED.
Finite coverage matrix: lifecycle stage × invariant × actor/handoff × success/failure/resume × affected host; every cell behavior+proof, not-applicable+reason, or blocked/needs-user+authority.

ContextCapsule contains raw request ref, effective requirements/decisions, current plan/task id, owned/forbidden scope, skill route receipt, capability plan/lease, evidence refs, remaining work and next action.

Skill lifecycle: SKILL.md canonical for activation class, deterministic trigger facts, negative triggers, capabilities, dependencies, explicit-only policy, provider requirements, rollback, eval status; ROUTE.json removed from canonical; exactly 34 global skills source/install hash parity; per-skill positive and negative route test; key workflow skills have live behavior canary.
Keep JOURNEY-001..014 in the catalog; GUI/login-dependent journeys use one bounded attempt plus a human residual.

Proof/closure: RunStore single writer; OutcomeReducer single reducer; evidence contains exact command/API/tool call, redacted args, exit code/result, hashes, timestamp, host/native surface, pre/post bytes, source/candidate digest, claim/acceptance refs.

Deliver 10 artifacts: baseline-and-loss-map, behavior-contract (coverage matrix/state vocab/module ownership), executable-plan (100% mapping + worker packets), behavior-index (json+md), native-host-matrix (8 hosts provenance/offline/live/rollback), skill-matrix (34 skills routing/eval/install hash), capability-matrix (skill/MCP/tool selection + live effects), evidence-ledger (source-bound raw observations), result.json (OutcomeReducer only), release-report (local gates/shas/workflows).
Local operational-readiness gate; not an absolute live-release gate.

MCP lifecycle: core install never installs/enables MCP; remove agent-rules-mcp-bridge from all host configs; preserve user MCP servers; integration is the only enable/disable path; MCP claim PASS requires 7-point canary; tasks without MCP prove no lease and no MCP call.

Native 8-host HostAdapter: detect/inventory/planInstall/install/reload/readback/offlineCanary/authenticatedCanary/rollback/uninstall; registry does not self-declare native; provenance required; UNSUPPORTED/BLOCKED if no official surface; atomic+idempotent, zero-diff reinstall, byte-equal rollback, ownership-hash managed blocks only; candidate digest covers tracked+staged+unstaged+untracked.

MCP lifecycle: core install never installs/enables MCP; remove agent-rules-mcp-bridge from all host configs; preserve user MCP servers; integration is the only enable/disable path; MCP claim PASS requires 7-point canary; tasks without MCP prove no lease and no MCP call.

Native 8-host HostAdapter: detect/inventory/planInstall/install/reload/readback/offlineCanary/authenticatedCanary/rollback/uninstall; registry does not self-declare native; provenance required; UNSUPPORTED/BLOCKED if no official surface; atomic+idempotent, zero-diff reinstall, byte-equal rollback, ownership-hash managed blocks only; candidate digest covers tracked+staged+unstaged+untracked.

Keep exactly 5 rules groups covering (1) intent/authority/scope/safety, (2) planning/delegation/reconcile/anti-loop, (3) proof/acceptance/outcome, (4) context/skills/tools/communication, (5) maintainer/native/release; restore lost invariants; parity matrix proves old behavior replacements.
Delete completely vibe-coder, plain-vietnamese, technical_explain, operator-profile command/runtime/test remnants and all automation/docs referencing these modes; no replacement modes.
Generated behavior-index: generated/behavior-index.json and generated/behavior-index.md with 10 canonical views; CLI reads the same index (status summary, status --details, doctor all --json).

Public CLI exactly 8 commands: install, uninstall, doctor, status, run, integration, init, reference; integration list|enable|disable|doctor; remove obsolete command modules/tests/aliases; docs/artifacts match.

Deterministic tests cover schema/semantic admission, trace chains, state transitions, single writer/atomic update, candidate digest change, stale/foreign evidence rejection, rules legacy parity + zero dead refs, skill hash parity, positive/negative routing, host adapter merge/idempotence/rollback/ownership, MCP lifecycle/teardown, 8-command CLI, and verify:all does not print failed-check then return success.

Process-level integration tests (12): two competing processes single-writer lock; kill-mid-transaction resume; context checkpoint→restart→capsule; plan-only handoff loads skills; scope conflict blocked; reconcile classified; skill resolver once per context generation; capability lease (MCP yes/no); MCP canary handshake/list/call; native installer on temp home + byte-equal rollback; packaged CLI loads runtime not source; hard-coded PASS verifier fails mutation test.
Keep JOURNEY-001..014 in the catalog; GUI/login-dependent journeys use one bounded attempt plus a human residual.
Local operational-readiness gate; not an absolute live-release gate.
Fix and validate the workflow definition locally; remote CI remains owner-run after handoff.
Commit integration, fast-forward main, push origin/main, observe CI and clean up safely.
